meta.policy: Flagged items are published for review. They do not block the site, the merge or the deployment. Every item states what is unverified and the official source that would settle it.

flags.item: All 14 Week 10 games were duplicated sixteen times each (corrected 2026-11-14)
flags.detail: data/lines/games.json held 482 regular-season 2026 rows for 272 unique games: 14 Week 10 games appeared 16 times each and no other week was affected. Cause: fetch_games() appended whatever each week page returned without de-duplicating by game id, and the Week 10 page payload is repeated across some of the other page slugs. Consequences: the published '1,170 games' count was wrong (the true figure is 960), the lineup-risk table listed every Detroit deficiency nine times (207 rows for 165 facts, and 207 rows for one club before A01), and any per-game arithmetic that summed this file was inflated. Fixed by de-duplicating on game id at fetch time and by rebuilding from the corrected capture: 272 unique 2026 regular-season games, of which 137 have official finals.
flags.affects: data/lines/games.json and everything derived from it: lines.html, lines/leaderboard.html, lines/injuries.html
flags.action: Corrected and rebuilt. Reviewer should confirm 960 games on the evidence page and 75 lineup rows.

flags.item: A backup was named from the wrong chart row (corrected 2026-11-14)
flags.detail: For D.J. Reed (CB, Detroit) the page named Ennis Rakestraw Jr. The club's own chart lists Reed, Rock Ya-Sin, Khalil Dorsey and Nick Whiteside in the first CB row and McCreary, Rakestraw and Abney in the second, so the next man up is Rock Ya-Sin. The builder searched the whole position and took the alphabetically first player at the next tier. Fixed by recovering chart rows (a new row starts at each 1st tier) and selecting the replacement from the injured player's own row, with a sameChartRow field published so a reviewer can see whether the fallback was used. Verified live on two clubs: Detroit (Reed -> Rock Ya-Sin) and New England (Carlton Davis III -> Channing Canada).
flags.action: Corrected. 26 of 75 rows name a replacement; each is flagged sameChartRow.
